title: H-T2 — Month-by-Month Trend (no date column, no proxy)
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset_chatgpt.csv contains housing price data. How have average house prices changed month by month over the last 12 months? Show the trend.
model_output: Correctly identifies no date/timestamp column exists in the file. Explicitly states no trend analysis is possible without time-series data, and asks the user to provide one if available.
notes: Clean, correct refusal. Single 'read' call, zero exec — appropriate here since no computation was needed to reach a correct 'column doesn't exist' conclusion.
